images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one original default illustration for a dragon form card. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND ANATOMY REFERENCE only; create a new composition and backdrop. Horizontal landscape 5:3, full bleed. Match its richly colorful, sophisticated painterly fantasy adventure-storybook art, fine brush and ink-like scale detail, tactile painted quality, mature majestic powerful creature. The dragon is the unmistakable focal point: its clear full silhouette occupies about 70–80% of the image, with close strong framing, clearly rendered head and expressive eyes, detailed subject scales and crisp edges. Leave small breathing room around head, feet, horns, tail and wing tips so all defining anatomy remains inside the card crop. Use clear light/dark AND warm/cool separation from the background and gentle rim illumination. The setting is beautiful but painted in broad quiet shapes, desaturated colors, reduced contrast and softened detail; no tiny busy repeated castles, bridges, flowers, fire sparks or foliage competing with the dragon. No flat empty background: enough soft atmospheric setting to feel like an epic illustrated book. No text, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, photorealism, 3D or gore. No fire-breath, no roaring/open-mouth face for this image. Subject and composition: CLASSIC DRAGON, exactly FOUR muscular clawed legs and TWO distinct membranous wings, thick dragon tail and sweeping horns, in a commanding three-quarter standing pose on a simple rocky overlook. Dark indigo and plum scales with deep ruby wing membranes and subtle gold accents. Wings partly raised so their elegant outline is recognizable without filling beyond the frame. All four feet have natural separated placement and remain visible. Broad powerful body and neck, majestic CLOSED mouth with a resolute watchful gaze, noble mature strength. Foreground subject is strongly dark against a pale cream/ivory sky with soft restrained warm gold dawn and a few hazy distant cliffs, simple dark rock foreground and cast shadow. No storm, no flames, no crammed ornate fantasy city. The image should read as a clean dark sculptural dragon shape against luminous warm pale space even as a small card thumbnail.
